# Quizard

> Turn your PDF, PPTX, DOCX or text documents into practice quizzes. 100% offline and private — files and scores never leave the device.

## Product

Quizard is an offline-first study PWA: import a document and it extracts the text locally and generates multiple-choice, true/false, fill-in-the-blank, identification, matching, ordering and short-answer quizzes.

- [App homepage](https://quizard-app.github.io/)
- [PWA manifest](https://quizard-app.github.io/manifest.webmanifest)
- [Service worker](https://quizard-app.github.io/sw.js)

## Tech notes

- Static Vite PWA (vanilla JS modules, no framework). Data in IndexedDB; settings in localStorage.
- Optional AI features call Google's Gemini API directly from the browser using the user's own free key (BYOK) — the key is stored only on the user's device.
- Source repository: [github.com/quizard-app/quizard-app.github.io](https://github.com/quizard-app/quizard-app.github.io)
